_note: Customer-safe self-help sections merged into the seed KB. Steps shown to customers may cite ONLY these sections (#h1, #h2 ...); admin-only checks (#c1 ...) never reach the customer view.
KB-BB-DROP: Restart the router: switch it off at the wall, wait 30 seconds, and switch it back on. Wait 3 minutes for all lights to settle.
Note the exact times the connection drops and which devices are affected - this helps us find a pattern.
If you can, connect a laptop with an Ethernet cable and check whether it also disconnects at the same times.
Make sure the router is not on the floor, inside a cabinet, or next to a microwave or cordless phone base.
KB-BB-SLOW: Run a speed test on a device connected with an Ethernet cable, with other downloads and streaming paused.
Repeat the test at different times of the day (morning, evening) and note the results.
Restart the router and test again; compare the result with the speed on your plan.
KB-BB-WIFI: Check whether a device connected with a cable, or one held next to the router, works normally.
Move the router to a raised, central spot away from thick walls, mirrors and metal furniture.
If your router shows two networks (2.4 GHz and 5 GHz), use 2.4 GHz for far rooms and 5 GHz near the router.
KB-FIBER-LOS: Check that the fiber box (ONT) is powered on and note which lights are on, and whether LOS is red, blinking or off.
Gently check that the thin fiber cable into the ONT is not bent sharply, pinched or unplugged. Do not look into the fiber end.
Restart the ONT and router once. If the LOS light stays red, the line needs a technician - do not keep restarting.
KB-BB-OUTAGE: Check whether neighbours or other flats in your building are also without internet.
Check the service status page or app for a known outage in your area before restarting equipment.
Keep your router powered on so it reconnects automatically when the service is restored.
KB-MOB-DATA: Turn Airplane mode on for 10 seconds, then off again.
Check that Mobile data is switched on and that your data pack is active and not exhausted.
Check APN settings: reset network settings or select the operator's default APN, then restart the phone.
KB-MOB-CALL: Restart your phone and check that it shows your operator name and signal bars.
Check that call forwarding, call barring and Do Not Disturb are switched off.
Try the SIM in another phone, if available, to see whether the issue follows the SIM.
KB-MOB-OTP: Ask a friend to send you a normal SMS to confirm that regular messages arrive.
Check that the sender is not blocked or filtered as spam in your messaging app, and that DND settings allow transactional messages.
Make sure your inbox is not full and restart the phone. Never share an OTP with anyone, including support.
KB-MOB-ROAM: Check that International Roaming is enabled on your plan and in the phone settings (Data roaming ON).
Open network settings and choose a partner network manually instead of automatic selection.
Turn Airplane mode on and off, or restart the phone, after arriving in the new country.
KB-SIM-ACT: Restart the phone and wait up to 30 minutes after the activation message for the network to register the SIM.
Remove and re-insert the SIM firmly, and check it in another phone if possible.
If it still shows no service, support will verify your identity through the secure process - never share your full ID number in chat.
KB-ESIM-QR: Check that your phone supports eSIM and is connected to Wi-Fi during the download.
Check whether an eSIM profile already appears in Settings > Mobile/Cellular before scanning again.
Do not share the QR code or activation code with anyone; if it says already used, support must reissue it securely.
KB-BILL-EXTRA: Open your latest bill and note the exact line item, amount and billing period you do not recognise.
Check whether any add-on, value-added service or roaming usage was active during that period.
Share only the line item and amount with support - never share full card or bank details.
KB-BILL-PAY: Keep the payment reference / transaction ID and the date and amount of the payment ready.
Allow up to 2 hours for online payments to reflect, then refresh the app or portal.
Do not pay again for the same bill while the first payment is being traced.
KB-PLAN-RENEW: Check the recharge status and transaction ID in your payment app or bank statement.
Restart your phone so it receives the updated plan, then check balance and validity in the app.
Note whether the money was debited; support will match it with your plan activation.
KB-PORT-DELAY: Check the porting SMS for your port request status and the scheduled date and time.
Keep both the old and new SIMs with you; restart the phone with the new SIM after the scheduled window.
If neither SIM works after the window, tell support right away - this is treated as urgent.
KB-TV-PIXEL: Note which channels are affected and whether it happens at particular times or in bad weather.
Check that the cable between the set-top box and the wall/dish is firmly connected (do not climb to reach a dish).
Restart the set-top box by switching it off at the wall for 30 seconds.
